routesElsewhere.goesTo: report.combined.run — UC-24-19, the Super Admin alone.

steps.note: One read, against the attendance records, treating closed days, leave, suspension and meeting days as those records treat them (BR-5). The run is recorded (BR-9).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Without the permission or a period nothing runs. Unmarked days are reported as unmarked.
plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing (BR-8); the only write is the record of the run (BR-9).

operations.name: report.attendance.run
operations.purpose: Run an attendance report from the catalogue.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No attendance report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's attendance group: Daily attendance register per section; Absentees today, school-wide; Monthly attendance summary per student; Attendance percentage per student; Student leave taken, by type; Late arrivals; Staff attendance for the month. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: period
parameters.notes: The date, the date range or the month (BR-2). Set by the reader, never assumed (E3).

parameters.name: class_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No class this reader may see matches.

parameters.notes: Where the report covers a class.

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No section this reader may see matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching sections with their class.

parameters.notes: Where the report covers a section. A teacher is offered only their own (BR-3, A1, E2).

parameters.name: staff_group_id
parameters.notes: Where the report covers staff rather than students (BR-2).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: payable_days
fields.description: On the staff report for the month: the figure payroll calculates from (BR-4).

fields.name: unmarked_days
fields.description: Days in the period with no attendance marked — reported as unmarked, never as present or absent (E4).

fields.name: percentage_basis
fields.description: Working days only. Closed days, leave, suspension and meeting days count against nobody (BR-5).

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission for this report.
A teacher asked for a section they do not teach.
Attendance was not marked for some days in the period.
errors.note: Those days read unmarked rather than as everybody present or everybody absent (AC-7).
Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-9).

planningRules.rule: Never assume the period. Ask where the request gives none — the reader sets it before the report runs, and a report run over the wrong period is read as though it were the right one.

Say that the staff figure for the month is the payroll input. Payroll reads the same records, so the two cannot disagree — and a wrong figure here is a wrong salary, to be corrected before payroll runs (BR-4, AC-6).
Never count a closed day, leave, a suspended day or a meeting day as an absence or against a percentage. Each is reported as the attendance records hold it (BR-5, A2, A3, A4, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5).
Report an unmarked day as unmarked. It is neither everybody present nor everybody absent (E4, AC-7).
A teacher gets the register for their own section and nothing wider (BR-3, A1, E2, AC-1).
Say what is not here. Chronic absence and patterns are not reported (BR-6, E7), and neither are sections still unmarked today (BR-7).
Say where a late arrival sits. It is modelled as present in the percentage and counted on the late report, and that is not confirmed (OQ-2).
Never correct anything from a report. A wrong mark is corrected through the attendance correction route (BR-8, E5, AC-8).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-9, BR-10).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-9).

request.text: November ki staff attendance report chahiye payroll ke liye
request.gloss: I need November's staff attendance report for payroll

resolvedPlans.context: Accounts, Johar Town. Two days in November have no staff attendance marked for the science department.
resolvedPlans.outcome: The month's payable days per employee — the same figure payroll calculates from. The two unmarked days for the science department are reported as unmarked; say they need marking or correcting before payroll runs, since a wrong figure here is a wrong salary.

request.text: aaj school mein kaun kaun absent hai?
request.gloss: who is absent in school today?

resolvedPlans.outcome: Today's absentees across the school. Children on approved leave or suspended are shown as such, not as absent.

operations.name: attendance.child.summary.read
operations.purpose: Return a guardian's own child's attendance for a month.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. None of this guardian's children matches (BR-3).
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the guardian's children with their class.

parameters.notes: One of the guardian's own children (BR-3, A5).

parameters.name: month
parameters.notes: The month. The current one where the request names none.

parameters.name: guardian_id
parameters.notes: The guardian's own portal account. Never from the request — a guardian reads only their own family.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: days
fields.description: Each day: present, absent, late, on leave, suspended, closed, meeting day, or unmarked (BR-5, E4).

fields.name: percentage
fields.description: Over working days only — closed days, leave, suspension and meeting days count against nobody (BR-5).

fields.name: unmarked_days
fields.description: Days with no mark, shown as unmarked (E4).

operations.writesOnRead: The reading is recorded, as every report run is (BR-9, AC-10).

planningRules.rule: Only the guardian's own child (BR-3, A5, AC-2).
Never count a closed day, leave, a suspended day or a meeting day as an absence (BR-5, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5).
Report an unmarked day as unmarked, not as present or absent (E4).
A mark the guardian thinks is wrong is corrected by the school, through the attendance correction route (BR-8).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the reading stands (BR-9).

request.text: Ali October mein kitne din absent raha?
request.gloss: how many days was Ali absent in October?

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian, Ali in Grade 4. Two days of approved leave and one public holiday in October.
resolvedPlans.outcome: Absent on two days. Say that the two days of leave and the holiday are not absences and are not in the percentage.
